comments.body: DISCOVERED (emergent, blocks all 4 leaves): .gitignore has '.rebar/*' (only trusted_environments.yaml exempt), so ALL deliverable overlay files (.rebar/criteria_routing.json, .rebar/prompts/plan-review-project-portability.md, .rebar/plan_review_moves.json, .rebar/evals/plan-review-project-portability.eval.yaml) are gitignored and cannot be committed as-is.
